name: RustGPT_Bench_100
description: RustGPT_Bench_100 is a small, focused benchmark of 100 Rust programming problems designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to generate correct Rust code and solve systems-level programming tasks. Evaluation is typically performed via test-based verification of produced solutions. The suite targets Rust-specific language features and common programming patterns.
reputation: Niche, small-scale benchmark with limited but growing use among researchers working on Rust code generation.
